question: The marked price of a platinum ring is ₹52,300 and it is available for sale at two successive discounts of 20% and 4%. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the platinum ring? (Round off to the nearest rupee.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using fractional equivalents: 20% = 1/5 and 4% = 1/25

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − 1/5) × (1 − 1/25)

SP = 52300 × (4/5) × (24/25) = 52300 × (96 ÷ 125)

SP = 418.4 × 96 = 40166.4

Rounding off to the nearest integer, SP ≈ ₹40,166

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40,166.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹52,300

Successive discounts: D₁ = 20% and D₂ = 4%
